issues.text: New in round 2 (changed RLS pointer), not in the ledger. "every query" is absolute: PostgreSQL 17 docs: "Superusers and roles with the BYPASSRLS attribute always bypass the row security system ... Table owners normally bypass row security as well". The policy is evaluated "for each row prior to any conditions or functions coming from the user's query". Acceptable as a forward pointer; the exceptions belong to backend.l3.row-level-security.
